title: classify_nsfw input
description: Absolute path to a PNG image to check, plus optional decision settings. v1 decodes PNG only (8-bit RGB or RGBA, non-interlaced); JPEG and other formats are refused by name rather than guessed.

image_path.description: Absolute path to the PNG file. Files are read from the caller's granted filesystem, never uploaded.

quality.description: How many crops to score: fast = 1 center crop, balanced = 4 crops, accurate = 8 crops. Defaults to balanced.

threshold.description: Decision threshold; isNSFW is true when score >= threshold. Defaults to 0.5.

policy.description: standard counts all five heads; allowTopless counts all but nipples. Defaults to standard.
